headline: Geopolitical Tensions Drive Record Shift in Global Oil Tanker Usage
summary: The Middle East crisis has caused a record 75% of the global long-range-2 (LR2) tanker fleet to switch from transporting refined fuels to shipping crude oil. This shift reflects significant disruptions in global energy supply chains.
why: Changes in tanker usage patterns can lead to increased shipping costs and supply bottlenecks for refined products like diesel and gasoline, impacting global energy prices.
why_moved: Disruptions to the efficient transport of crude and refined products create supply uncertainty, which is immediately reflected in energy commodity futures.
